brief.headline: Close the 13.6% price gap to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG and cut our yearly overspend of ₹14.26 L

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match Sayaji Industries' ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: We pay Sayaji ₹66.48/KG for identical material — Dextrose Anhydrous IP. Universal charges us ₹75.51/KG, a 13.6% gap. Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sit in the ₹60–81/kg band, typically ₹66–73/kg — so ₹66.48 is market-fair and we already get it elsewhere.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Universal is stable and growing fast — sales up 21.4% per year and they keep ₹3.70 of every ₹100 they sell. They carry debt at 0.73x equity, so they're not stretched. But we're tiny to them: our ₹59.65 L is just 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr revenue. That means we have almost no individual pull, so our leverage comes from two things: their hunger for volume (they're growing fast and want orders), and our ability to walk to Sayaji or another supplier who already gives us ₹66.48/KG.

evidence.point: We pay Universal ₹75.51/KG but Sayaji only ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP
Closing that gap saves us ₹14.26 L every year
Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP typically run ₹66–73/kg, so ₹66.48 is fair
We're a very small customer — only 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr in sales
They're growing fast at 21.4% per year, so they want volume
They keep about ₹3.70 profit on every ₹100 sold and carry 0.73x debt-to-equity — financially stable

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker (₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health B 62/100) — an established dextrose supplier and a direct drop-in alternate to Sayaji.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist making starch and dextrose (₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C 57/100) — growing capacity.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller (₹365.39 Cr revenue, health D 27/100) producing Dextrose ANHYDROUS IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching.

risks: We're only 0.12% of their business (₹59.65 L vs ₹514.62 Cr), so on our own we have almost no leverage — they can easily say no unless we bundle more volume or show a credible alternate supplier.
They're growing fast (21.4%) and financially stable (3.7% margin, 0.73x debt), so they're not desperate — don't expect them to cave on price without a clear threat that we'll move volume elsewhere.

Sayaji at ₹66.48/KG is our anchor, but if we haven't bought from them recently or in large quantity, Universal may challenge whether that price is real or still available — be ready to show recent POs.
Tirupati (health D 27/100) is a weaker alternate — if we lead with them, Universal may dismiss the threat; open with Gulshan or Sanstar instead.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to keep buying from you, but right now we're paying ₹75.51/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP — let's talk about closing that gap.
